kultivator.kosmik.surga.name: The Heavenly Palace (Heaven)
kultivator.kosmik.surga.gerbang.name: The Southern Heaven Gate (Nantianmen)
kultivator.kosmik.surga.gerbang.source: Source: the Southern Heaven Gate (Nantianmen), guarded by the Heavenly King Zengzhang and the heavenly generals; its pillars are coiled by red-bearded, gold-scaled dragons (Journey to the West, Wu Cheng'en, chapter 4). Its 3D form is game design.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.aula.name: The Hall of Lingxiao (Lingxiao Baodian)
kultivator.kosmik.surga.aula.source: Source: the Lingxiao Hall (Lingxiao Baodian), the Jade Emperor's audience hall; chapter 4 of Journey to the West names thirty-three heavenly palaces and seventy-two halls. The layout is game design.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.cincin.name: The Nine Heavens
kultivator.kosmik.surga.cincin.source: Source: 'Heaven has nine fields' (天有九野): Juntian in the centre, then Cangtian, Biantian, Xuantian, Youtian, Haotian, Zhutian, Yantian, Yangtian (Lüshi Chunqiu, 'Youshi'; also Huainanzi chapter 3, 'Tianwen'). The ninefold heaven (九重) is asked about in the Chu Ci, 'Tian Wen'. The stacked rings are game design.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.laut_awan.name: The Sea of Clouds
kultivator.kosmik.surga.laut_awan.source: Source: a sea of clouds parting the mortal world from the heavenly realm is a common motif of xianxia stories; game design.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.pengawal.name: The Four Heavenly Kings
kultivator.kosmik.surga.pengawal.source: Source: the Four Heavenly Kings (Si Da Tianwang); in the Fengshen Yanyi the four Mo brothers are made the Four Heavenly Kings at the investiture of the gods at the end of the tale, and in Journey to the West they guard the gates of Heaven.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.tiang_naga.name: The Dragon Pillars
kultivator.kosmik.surga.tiang_naga.sourc: Source: the dragon-coiled pillars and the phoenix-adorned bridges at the gates of Heaven (Journey to the West, chapter 4).
kultivator.kosmik.surga.jembatan.name: The Jade Bridges
kultivator.kosmik.surga.jembatan.source: Source: the Jade Pool (Yaochi), where the Queen Mother of the West holds the Peach Banquet (Journey to the West, chapter 5); its jade bridges are game design.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.air_terjun.name: The Waterfalls of Light (the Heavenly River)
kultivator.kosmik.surga.air_terjun.sourc: Source: the Heavenly River (Tianhe), whose fleet Marshal Tianpeng commanded before he was banished and became Zhu Bajie (Journey to the West, chapter 19).
kultivator.kosmik.surga.kelopak.name: The Rain of Heavenly Flowers
kultivator.kosmik.surga.kelopak.source: Source: the rain of heavenly flowers (天花): the goddess who scatters flowers in the Vimalakirti Sutra, and the rain of mandarava flowers in the Lotus Sutra.
kultivator.kosmik.surga.tiang.name: The Sea-Stabilising Pillar
kultivator.kosmik.surga.tiang.source: Source: in Journey to the West (chapter 3) the Sea-Stabilising Pillar lies in the treasury of the Dragon King of the Eastern Sea; its release from the gate of Heaven is the Titah's game design.
